title: Indicators after extending paths
statement: Let $P$ be a finite list of paths, let $i$ be a coordinate absent from the support of every path in $P$, let $b\in\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Extend each path by assigning value $b$ at coordinate $i$. The sum of the extended paths' leaf outputs times their cylinder indicators at $x$ equals the original sum of outputs times cylinder indicators if $x_i=b$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of paths with real-valued leaf outputs
A coordinate absent from every path's support
